name: CM_ATTACHED_BFH
description: Table to contain information regarding Billing Follow-up History records attached to CRMs.

columns.name: COMM_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the communication record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: ATTACHED_BFH_ID
columns.description: Lists the Billing Follow-up history items on this customer service record.

columns.name: BFH_ENTRY_USER_ID
columns.description: The LPR ID of the user who completed the Billing account action.

columns.name: BFH_ENTRY_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: BFH_ENTRY_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: Instant of the last update to the BFH record.
